autoHide.title: Auto-hide
autoHide.description: Automatically hide the title bar and the sidebar.

overlayMode.title: Overlay mode
overlayMode.description: The title bar floats above the content instead of pushing it down.

copyYesterdayReadings.title: Copy yesterday's readings
copyYesterdayReadings.description: The "Daily readings" button will copy the readings from the previous day instead of today.

hotkeys.title: Keyboard navigation
hotkeys.description: Esc focuses the current route in the sidebar; the arrow keys browse and open routes. Numbers open a route directly.

enable.title: Enable global shortcuts
enable.description: Shortcuts are ignored while you type in a field.

hotkeys.automaticOrderNote: In automatic order, enabling or disabling Beta routes renumbers the shortcuts. After a manual change, your configuration is preserved.

backups.title: Weekly backup
backups.description: Lyceum checks once a week and only sends the selected groups. Opening the app does not trigger a new backup while the period has not expired.
backups.noBackupYet: No backup completed on this device
backups.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one kind of data

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Control how books appear when you browse the library tree.

showSubfolderBooks.title: Show books from subfolders
showSubfolderBooks.description: When enabled, a folder also lists the books stored in its subfolders.

unifiedView.title: Unified view
unifiedView.description: Regular folders appear in the library grid. Collections and merged books appear as book cards and follow the same filters.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Look for new versions, follow the download and install without closing and reopening Lyceum by hand.

status.disabled: Updates are only available in the installed app.
status.available: Update found. The download should start automatically.
status.notAvailable: You are using the latest version.
status.idle: No check has been made in this session.

updates.installLaterNote: If you do not install now, the update will be applied automatically when the application is closed.
updates.unavailable: Updates are unavailable in this environment
updates.alreadyLatest: You are already on the latest version
updates.installedAppOnly: Automatic updates only work in the installed app

personal.title: Personal information
personal.description: Data used to identify your account inside Lyceum.

account.name: Name
account.nicknameHint: Used to find friends in Lyceum.
account.invalidImageType: Use a JPG, PNG or WEBP image
account.imageTooLarge: The image must be at most 5MB

session.title: Session
session.description: End this user's access to the application.

account.signOutConfirmMessage: Do you really want to end your session in Lyceum?

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose between light and dark, or let Lyceum follow the system.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: The chosen color shows on focus, primary buttons, active states and small highlights.

performance.title: Visual effects
performance.description: On slower computers, blur, heavy shadows and animations can make the interface sluggish or freeze it.

reduceEffects.title: Reduce effects
reduceEffects.description: Removes background blur (backdrop-blur), large shadows and transition animations. Screens keep working normally.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts: Ctrl + / Ctrl - to adjust the zoom. Ctrl 0 to reset.

dictionaries.title: Offline dictionaries
dictionaries.description: Download local dictionaries for lookups and translation without depending on the network.

beta.title: Sidebar tabs in development
beta.description: Enable or disable each experimental feature in the sidebar.
